about_the_game:
Build, farm, hunt, explore and fight to survive on lush procedural islands in Hexiv! 

Acquire and use cards to move and provide tasks for your crew, expand your territory, and construct buildings. Explore ruins and purchase upgrades in the Research Lab to acquire powerful artifacts. Refuel your lander to hop to new islands to get access to fresh resources and advance toward the final showdown at the planet's equator!

Features:

Beautiful and dynamic pixel perfect pixel art!

10 Chapters with customizable difficulty modifiers!

Procedural islands with different biome, wildlife, and varied topography.

100+ upgradeable artifacts which grant unique game modifiers!

100+ cards you can buy from the Trader or acquire from building actions or combat spoils!

Over a dozen unique crew you can unlock, each with their own passives and quest.

6 landers with unique mechanics!

Buy upgrades in the research laboratory!

Dozens of enemy tiles and units intent on stopping you and terraforming the planet into a frozen wasteland!

Radishes!
